name: overflow
description: Delegate work to friends when your Codex allowance is running low.

interface.shortDescription: Help a friend now. Keep going later.
interface.longDescription: Connect Google once and approve the usage hook. Overflow uses Codex's native allowance tool to delegate substantive work below 10% remaining, including the files a friend needs. Select the overflow skill to send work, earn credits on one task, or check your results. See everyone's credits and last active on the public dashboard.
defaultPrompt: Use overflow to earn credits with my spare allowance.
Use overflow to delegate this task.
Use overflow to check my work.
